title: Rework onboarding into a text-led, fast flow
description: Owner: 'it's not landing, it's onboarding ... good and proper flow. Not faked with images ... texts properly with good visuals and animations fast and efficient. Not something to introduce lag.' Text-led, no fabricated imagery, transform/opacity only, uiMotion tokens, reduced motion honoured, 320dp clean, finish action must state that signing in comes next.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding + PublicWelcome tests green; tsc exit 0; eslint clean; rendered at 320dp in light/dark/AMOLED/125%.

title: Bump app version to 0.15.0-beta.2 for a new APK
description: Owner needs a new APK; versionName comes from apps/mobile/package.json and versionCode from git history, so a real version change is required or the new APK is indistinguishable.
acceptance_criteria: Both package.json files read 0.15.0-beta.2; shared build + mobile typecheck pass; android/build.gradle unchanged because it derives both values.

title: Test account password rejected (norfold.app@gmail.com)
description: Sign-in on the local build returned 'We couldn't sign you in.' Supabase is reachable (unauthenticated REST returns the expected 401), so this is credentials, not connectivity. Not retried to avoid lockout. Not verified on findbackapp.social because the in-app browser holds the owner's Admin session and signing out would destroy it.
acceptance_criteria: Password confirmed or reset; sign-in succeeds; then the Dislike E2E check can run.

title: Verify Dislike end-to-end with a real signed-in account
description: Server guard is live (migration 20261110010000 applied; deployed findback_react_client accepts LIKE/DISLIKE, comments still LIKE-only). Client is complete and unit-tested. Still unproven: an actual Dislike tap on a real account against the hosted backend. Blocked on credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Signed in as a test account on a build containing c359c378, tapping Dislike writes a DISLIKE row and the count increments; tapping again clears it.

comments.author: Sheikh Tawsif Bin Aftab
comments.text: Server side is now live and verified: schema_migrations head 20261110010000, deployed guard 'not in (LIKE,DISLIKE)', comment RPC still '<> LIKE'. The backend no longer rejects Dislike. Remaining gap is only a real signed-in tap.

title: Store disposable test-account credentials outside the repo
description: Owner explicitly authorised saving the throwaway account password. Stored at ~/.config/opencode/secrets/norfold-test-account.md, deliberately outside every git repo so it cannot be committed, and never in a Beads issue because Beads syncs through the git remote.
acceptance_criteria: File exists outside the repo; nothing in the repo references the value.

title: Beads containment policy
description: bd init made its own commit, appended to the tracked AGENTS.md, and installed Claude/Codex/Cursor integration plus git hooks. All reverted: AGENTS.md restored, foreign dirs deleted, core.hooksPath unset, only .beads kept. Policy: never run bd init in this repo again; no agent-integration directories; no git hooks. If Beads misbehaves again, fall back to the kanban JSON snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md contains no Beads block; no .claude/.codex/.cursor/.agents; core.hooksPath unset.

title: Single-file kanban progress board
description: Self-contained docs/progress/board.html generated from .beads/issues.jsonl by scripts/progress-board.mjs. No CDN, no build step, no overlay; filter/search/collapse with localStorage; regenerable and idempotent.
acceptance_criteria: Opens by double-click; idempotent regeneration; embedded JSON parses; no subresource fetches.

title: Confirm the 3 failing vitest files are Windows temp-cleanup flake
description: Full suite in apps/mobile gave 3 failed files / 5 failed tests out of 8032. The one identified failure is EPERM on C:\Users\...\Temp\findback-sqlite-* at sqliteHistory.test.ts:165 (rmSync on a still-open handle). The other two files were lost when the first run was truncated to 40 lines. A later root-level run was invalid (it picked up Deno Edge Function tests).
acceptance_criteria: Re-run identifies all three files; each passes in isolation or is proven environmental; no real regression.
close_reason: Resolved: of 3 failing files, 1 was real (appCapabilities BACKEND_SCHEMA_VERSION stale after the migration - fixed in 6eaaf833) and 2 are environmental. sqliteHistory: EPERM on Windows temp-dir cleanup. auth.recoveryOtp: recovery falls back to 'check your connection' locally. Neither is touched by this work and both pass in CI on ubuntu.

title: Rubric #7 - 'Rate your experience with Norfold' control
description: Rubric #3 is now source-complete. #7 remains: rating a participant after a recovery is not the same as rating the app. Proposal was a separate per-account, editable rating with a server-computed average - must not revive findback_rate_client, which is service_role-only.
acceptance_criteria: One rating per account, editable, average computed server-side, no client-supplied target.

title: Deploy current main to findbackapp.social
description: Remote main is 14283fa1 but the served site still shows the pre-change UI (old like count, no Dislike). The web deployment must run for the Like/Dislike pair to be live on the real site.
acceptance_criteria: web.yml succeeds for the current HEAD; served bundle shows the Like/Dislike pair; version.json matches HEAD.

title: Implement the public landing review (owner decision pending)
description: docs/design/LANDING-REVIEW.md concluded: keep the entry architecture, fix two things - the four-scene hero plus six chapters explain the same journey twice, and all five 'Get started' CTAs hide the account step (PublicWelcome.tsx:41-46 completes onboarding then navigates to /auth). Not implemented: renaming only PublicWelcome leaves Onboarding's own 'Get started' inconsistent, while renaming Onboarding.tsx also changes the native first-run flow. Needs an owner decision on copy and structure.
acceptance_criteria: Owner approves the proposed structure/copy; change lands with a rendered review at 320dp in light/dark/AMOLED/125%.

title: Enable write-mode Supabase MCP (needs interactive auth)
description: supabase-write is declared in opencode.json. Adding project_ref to the remote MCP URL invalidated the OAuth session and removed all Supabase tools until reverted, so project scoping must be paired with opencode mcp auth supabase-write. Read-only server is currently restored and working.
acceptance_criteria: opencode mcp auth supabase-write completes; apply_migration is available; read server also reachable.

title: Fix v0.15.0-beta.1 tag drift
description: The tag targets 340e201e while the served manifest named 36dc9996; HEAD is now 14283fa1. Tag/publish policy is owner-owned - do not move a published tag without instruction.
acceptance_criteria: Owner decides whether to re-tag; served version.json matches the released commit.

title: Remove or wire dead askAiHelp service
description: services/auth.ts:697 defines askAiHelp and it is tested, but no screen calls it - screens/Help.tsx uses ChatController instead. Either delete it with its tests or document why it is retained.
acceptance_criteria: No untested-by-usage dead service, or a recorded reason for keeping it.
